watch.summary: The streamer aggressively demolishes an opposing goalie in Rocket League to secure a goal, then cracks up at how disrespectful the play was.

beats.what: Streamer flies down the side wall toward the enemy net.
Streamer targets the opponent defending the goal.
Streamer demolishes the opponent right before the ball goes into the net.
Streamer laughs in disbelief and admits how toxic the play was.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: That was actually so toxic, what the heck!
watch.why: The comedy relies on the streamer's self-aware amusement after executing a ruthless, aggressive play against his opponent. His genuine laughter makes the moment relatable to anyone who has played competitive multiplayer games.
